scope: Isolated CPU gate/fold methods; no full framework, optimizer or CLIP execution

execution_attempts.reason: Audit harness omitted torch.Tensor annotation binding; corrected before any matrix evaluation

driver_observation: NUFILT.solve_lora sums FilterLoRA.solve_lora matrix objectives, runs Adam, then merge_model folds before taskpool.evaluate. Matrix loss uses TBA, same as folded formula. This finding does not invalidate reported paper accuracy.
gate_observation: Gate forward uses row transform X(P+BA); fold creates column weight T(P+BA). They need not have equal forward outputs for nonsymmetric BA.
